SELECT
    r.assignment_id,
    r.level_2_full_code,
    r.level_3_name,
    r.level_4_name,
    r.level_6_full_code,
    r.level_6_name,
    r.nama_principal,
    s.no_usaha,
    s.nama_usaha,
    s.kbli_akhir,
    s.tahun_operasi,
    s.tk_dibayar,
    s.gaji,
    s.gaji_bln,
    r.assignment_status_alias,
    CONCAT('https://fasih-sm.bps.go.id/app/assignment/fd68e454-ba45-4b85-8205-f3bf777ded24/', r.assignment_id) AS Link_assignment
FROM tgr_fd68e454.root_table r
-- Aturan 1: Wajib JOIN ke base_table_assignment dan filter is_active = 1
INNER JOIN tgr_fd68e454.base_table_assignment b
    ON r.assignment_id = b.assignment_id
    AND b.is_active = 1
-- Aturan 2: Wajib JOIN root_table ke tabel roster menggunakan assignment_id dan assignment_date_modified
-- (se2026_nested sudah granular per usaha via index1/no_usaha, tidak perlu join dedup tambahan)
INNER JOIN tgr_fd68e454.se2026_nested s
    ON r.assignment_id = s.assignment_id
    AND r.assignment_date_modified = s.assignment_date_modified
    AND s.keberadaan_usaha_value IN (1, 2)
WHERE
    COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(s.tk_dibayar, '') AS DOUBLE), 0) > 0
    AND (
        -- Usaha lama (beroperasi sebelum 2026): pakai gaji setahun terakhir (r26a)
        (
            COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(s.tahun_operasi, '') AS INT), 0) < 2026
            AND (
                COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(s.gaji, '') AS DOUBLE), 0)
                / NULLIF(COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(s.tk_dibayar, '') AS DOUBLE), 0), 0)
            ) < 100000
        )
        OR
        -- Usaha baru (mulai beroperasi tahun 2026): pakai gaji sebulan terakhir (r30a)
        (
            COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(s.tahun_operasi, '') AS INT), 0) = 2026
            AND (
                COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(s.gaji_bln, '') AS DOUBLE), 0)
                / NULLIF(COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(s.tk_dibayar, '') AS DOUBLE), 0), 0)
            ) < 100000

-- Keterangan : Rasio nilai tambah Kategori A < 0,6 atau Rasio nilai tambah Kategori A > 0,79673 (ID Indikator: 12)
-- Kondisi    : 
-- 1. Kategori Usaha = 'A'
-- 2. Usaha beroperasi < 2026  : (Pendapatan Thn - Total Biaya Thn) / Pendapatan Thn < 0.6
-- 3. Usaha beroperasi >= 2026 : (Pendapatan Bln - Total Biaya Bln) / Pendapatan Bln < 0.6
-- 4. Usaha beroperasi < 2026  : (Pendapatan Thn - Total Biaya Thn) / Pendapatan Thn > 0.79673
-- 5. Usaha beroperasi >= 2026 : (Pendapatan Bln - Total Biaya Bln) / Pendapatan Bln > 0.79673

SELECT
    a.level_6_code AS kode_wilayah,
    18 AS id_indikator,
    a.level_1_code,
    a.level_2_code,
    a.level_3_code,
    a.level_4_code,
    a.level_5_code,
    a.level_6_code,
    a.assignment_id,
    CONCAT('https://fasih-sm.bps.go.id/app/assignment-detail/', a.assignment_id) AS link_fasih_sm,
    a.nama_usaha,
    a.kategori,
    a.kbli_label,
    a.kbli_genai_label,
    a.tahun_operasi,
    a.rasio_keuntungan,
    a.date_modified

    SELECT
        a.assignment_id,
        a.level_1_full_code AS level_1_code,
